unity_embedding_baseline.timing_scope: HTTP request through all-token embedding JSON validation and original legal-token LM head. Model startup, file hashing and one separately recorded warm-up are excluded.

limitations: These 18 cases have no gold action labels or game outcomes; agreement with TinyJev is not accuracy.
TinyJev uses upstream Torch FP32 and Transformers 5.3; Intern uses upstream HF BF16 and Transformers 5.14.1. Timing/footprint are implementation-level observations, not architecture-only comparisons.
The same state/questions/candidate order are preserved, but native chat templates and token counts differ.
Published Intern-Decision paper Jev comparisons refer to a different hosted Jev baseline, not this TinyJev 0.6B trial.
Only text inputs and CPU were exercised; GPU/image performance and game integration were not measured. 2B was tested only in native Python; the Unity runner is pinned to 0.8B.
Unity uses F16 GGUF and original HF numeric token IDs. Native string tokenizer parity is not asserted.
Unity probability differences are recorded separately from selected-choice agreement; the 0.02 diagnostic threshold is not adjusted to turn failures into passes.
Each case was measured once after one warmup; these are observations for this 4-core cloud environment, not a latency distribution or game target performance guarantee.
Unity RSS observations reuse one Editor across routes and include Editor state; they do not establish minimum model-only memory.

unity_completion.backend: LLMUnity 3.0.3 / LlamaLib 2.0.5 CPU, single-position original LM-head legal-token conditional probabilities
unity_completion.parity_scope: Agreement and probability difference against pinned original HF results. The 0.02 threshold is a numerical diagnostic, not decision quality or game success.
unity_completion.timing_scope: Cached-mask request construction through native causal-prefix forward, original vocabulary LM head, explicit eight-token logit masking/T=1 probability calculation and HTTP parsing. No free-form answer is used; own argmax chooses the strategy. Native model/head/sampler costs are inseparable; head_ms=0 means no separate managed-head stage. Startup, file hashing and one separately recorded warm-up are excluded.
unity_completion.memory_scope: Main Editor RSS sampled externally, including prior Editor state. This is the same Editor reused after the embedding baseline, not a fresh-process minimum or VRAM. Child RSS sum is omitted to avoid shared-page double counting.

case_results.probability_source: Native original LM head, illegal vocabulary logits masked before top_k=8 and T=1 softmax; direct legal conditional probabilities. Raw logits are unavailable.

pretokenizer_compatibility.adapter: Exact upstream Qwen3.5 pre-tokenizer recognition backport
pretokenizer_compatibility.loader_difference: Transformers reconstructed a different effective pre-tokenizer from the untouched checkpoint JSON. The exported input IDs still use this exact native HF loader; GGUF qwen35 metadata describes the checkpoint regex.
pretokenizer_compatibility.scope: Recognition only; original tokenizer vocabulary, merges, IDs and trained weights are unchanged.
pretokenizer_compatibility.unity_input_scope: Only the exported native HF raw token IDs are compared. Text tokenization parity is not asserted.
